title: fetch the descendants of and link a module script only handles [[ParseError]] case
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

In [fetch the descendants and link a module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script), it will call [LoadRequestedModules](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-LoadRequestedModules) to fetch the descendants, which will in turn call [HostLoadImportedModules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#hostloadimportedmodule).
And if there's any exception thrown during [HostLoadImportedModules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#hostloadimportedmodule), it will call [FinishLoadingImportedModule](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-FinishLoadingImportedModule).
But only the ParseError case, which is handled in step 14.3.3 of  [HostLoadImportedModules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#hostloadimportedmodule), will be passed to the loadState.[[ParseError]]

> If loadState is not undefined and loadState.[[ParseError]] is null, set loadState.[[ParseError]] to parseError.

Then the loadPromise from LoadRequestedModules will be rejected, in step 7.1 of [fetch the descendants and link a module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script)

> If state.[[ParseError]] is not null, set moduleScript's [error to rethrow](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-script-error-to-rethrow) to state.[[ParseError]] and run onComplete given moduleScript.

But what about the other errors thrown during  [HostLoadImportedModules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#hostloadimportedmodule)? For example, when the [module type allowed](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#module-type-allowed) returns false, or when the resolutionError is thrown in Step 9. These doesn't set the [[ParseError]] state, hence when the loadPromise is rejected in [fetch the descendants and link a module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script), it will run step 7.2.

> Otherwise, run onComplete given null.

This will lead to [the onerror handler of the script will be called](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#execute-the-script-element),

The change is made from #8253, but contradicts the original behavior.
Originally, resolution errors and errors for module types were treated as parse errors.
https://web.archive.org/web/20221130124954/https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#validate-requested-module-specifiers

The wpt, [/import-maps/bare-specifiers.sub.html], and [/html/semantics/scripting-1/the-script-element/import-attributes/invalid-type-attribute-error.html] still expect the legacy behavior

CCing @nicolo-ribaudo
